evidence.summary: SASTIND lists CETC among China’s defence-industry group companies (军工集团). CETC says it holds the leading technical position in China’s military electronics and cyber and information fields, and that its mission includes national defence modernisation.

CETC describes itself as a key state-owned enterprise administered directly by the central government, descended from ministries including the Fourth Ministry of Machine-Building and the defence science commission’s Tenth Research Academy.
